summary: Avalo Therapeutics filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $200,000,000 of common stock under an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC dated November 5, 2026. Shares may be sold from time to time via negotiated transactions, block trades or ATM methods on Nasdaq under symbol AVTX; Jefferies receives up to 3.0% gross proceeds commission. Last reported sale price was $7.07 on November 4, 2026. No escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM facility, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any acceleration in sales volume.
